ns2:course.label: Topics in Vocal Music
ns2:course.description: Intensive or comparative study of specific repertoires of vocal music, of particular genres or styles of vocal composition or performance practice, and/or of particular vocal artists. 4 graduate hours. No professional credit. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: MUS 528A, graduate standing in musicology, or consent of instructor. For graduate students in Music.
